ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) field with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels, estimated at 1:12 global coverage.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark uniform base; high-contrast white pixel clusters are scattered as non-contiguous points across the entire surface; no large-scale geometric pigmentation blobs (mottling) are present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 105 degrees; vertical notch depth is roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (3-8 pixel variations) along the distal trailing edges; distinct irregular notch present on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep from the central axis transitioning to a concave taper toward the distal tips along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial distribution of circular high-contrast white clusters (5-20 pixel diameter) globally; highest concentrations identified in the distal region of the right lobe and upper-medial region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white linear disruptions; notable parallel diagonal tracks on the left lobe center and isolated horizontal/vertical marks across the right lobe upper quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring patterns across the ventral surface including circular barnacle scars and linear rake marks; irregular erosion/nicks along the left lobe trailing edge.
